description.value: The Public Mineral Pool in Harrison Hot Springs is an indoor facility fed by the area's famous natural mineral hot springs, one of the most celebrated hot spring destinations in British Columbia. Operated as a public pool on Hot Springs Road, it offers access to geothermally heated mineral water in a setting long prized for its restorative qualities. For a touring cyclist arriving after a long day in the saddle, a soak here would be a memorable highlight of the Harrison River Valley.
